name: Kibble Dispenser Outdoor

kit.electronics: electronics box pre-assembled and tested, closed inside the pre-assembled dispenser unit
contents: dispenser unit, pre-assembled and closed (pod, dosing core, drive, electronics box, cap with the control panel: push-button, 2 LEDs with light pipes, speaker with acoustic membrane)
flange set, pre-assembled (two flange plates, dowel pin, gate blade, interlock ring, skirt lip) and the cable grommet
funnel collar, shelf gasket, 4 wood screws 5x35, 12 V supply cable with M8 connector, UV cable tie, drilling template

notes: No product release yet. The first, product-v1.0.0, will pin a tested hardware release and a firmware release that has run on it. The planned kit follows the split of design v6.3 (hardware/v6.3/cad/v63.json, kit_split); hardware 6.3 needs the one-button firmware of issue #2.
Changes that only touch the kit (enclosure, packaging, manual) bump the product version without a new hardware or firmware tag.
